applies_why: The judge declares the challenge underdetermined because neither text's own words state the contrary, which invokes the retired stating-verse test that K-C governs.
quote: the verb change is real [L1]/[L2] but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: the phrase 'no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires' — I weighed reading it as barring an underdetermined verdict based on absent contrary wording versus reading it as only barring a positive contrary finding.
why: K-C requires the pressing side's own chain to be weighed chain against chain by footing, but the judge instead rests on the absence of a verse stating the contrary in its own words.
